info.name: Pixora — All Sprints (Complete API + Test Mapping)
info.description:
## Setup
1. Import this file in Postman (Import → file).
2. Open the collection **Variables** tab and set: `baseUrl`, `agencyId`, `subAccountId`, `priceId` (from **Sprint 2 → Plan prices**), `connectAccountId`, `productId`, `messageId`, `conversationId` as needed.
3. Run **Sprint 1 → Signin valid (save token)** or **Signup valid**; scripts store JWT in `token`.
4. For cookie routes (Stripe subscription, chat), the collection uses `Cookie: auth_token={{token}}`.

## Badges in test names
- **PASS** — happy path
- **FAIL_EXPECTED** — request should error (4xx); test passes when status matches
- **EDGE** — boundary / security / infra

## Newman (CI)
```bash
newman run postman/pixora-sprints-complete.postman_collection.json \
  --env-var baseUrl=https://your-domain.com \
  --env-var agencyId=UUID \
  --env-var subAccountId=UUID \
  --reporters cli,htmlextra
```

## Server Actions / UI-only features
Sprints 3–6 include requests that **proxy** real endpoints or document coverage. Funnel editor, Kanban, notifications UI, and full analytics are covered by **Bun unit tests** under `tests/unit/` (see per-request descriptions).
